questions.question: Which provincial union holds the record for 'Most Wins' (combined T20 + List A)?
In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Boland or Lions?
Who has achieved the 50+ runs and 4+ wickets in a match double more times, Sunette Loubser or Shandré Fritz?
questions.explanation: Sunette Loubser: 1 times. Shandré Fritz: 2 times.

questions.question: At St. Andrews Hickling, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (List A)?
What is South Africa Women's best-ever finish at a Cricket World Cup, achieved for the first time in 2025?
questions.explanation: South Africa reached their first-ever Women's World Cup final in 2025, finishing runners-up to India.

questions.question: Who topped the runs charts in the 17/18 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade led with 207 runs, a joint record shared with Stacey Lackay.
